q: The Dread Pirate Roberts is one single pirate who never dies.
explain: False. It is a name passed from pirate to pirate. Westley got it from the last Roberts, who retired.

q: What does Westley really mean when he says 'As you wish'?
explain: That day, she was amazed to discover that when he was saying 'As you wish', what he meant was 'I love you.'

q: How does Westley beat Vizzini in the battle of wits?
